fault_notes: The customer has lost several TV channels following a recent software update. The agent never paraphrases or restates the customer's issue to confirm understanding, but otherwise follows a professional troubleshooting process and works towards resolving the fault. [On saving: empathy added, the customer says "quite frustrating" (00:33) and "just annoying" (04:29) and the agent never acknowledges either. Agent sentiment removed.]

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net. You're speaking with Rachel. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Rachel, my name's Daniel Foster. My TV channels have disappeared since the update yesterday evening.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can look into that for you. Could I have your S-Net account number, please?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's 583104762. It's quite frustrating because some of the channels I watch every day are just gone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. For security, could you confirm the first line of your registered address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's 42 Oakfield Road, Bristol.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Daniel. I've verified the account. I'll check your TV package and the service information first.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sure. I noticed it after the box restarted for the update. A few channels are still there, but quite a lot aren't.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your account shows the Entertainment package with the additional Variety add-on. I'll check whether there are any service notices.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've checked the S-Net website and couldn't see anything about an outage. Is there anything showing on your side?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: There isn't a general TV service incident listed for your area. I'll check the status of your set-top box next.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. The box seems to turn on normally. The menus look different since the update, though.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Has the box displayed any error messages, either when it started up or when you selected one of the missing channels?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Not really. Some channels say they're unavailable, while others don't appear in the guide at all.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When you open the TV guide, do the channel numbers remain in place with a blank listing, or have the numbers disappeared as well?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Both, actually. Some numbers are missing completely, and on a few others the number is there but the programme won't play.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks. I'll check the box software version and see whether the update completed successfully.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I hope so. It said the update was complete, and then the box restarted on its own.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The software version is current. I'm going to check whether the channel list is synchronised with your subscription.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right. I haven't changed my package, so I wouldn't expect those channels to disappear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your package is still active, and the add-on is showing correctly. I'll refresh the channel entitlements from here.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does that mean I won't need to change anything on the box myself?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let's try the refresh first. It may take a minute or two to reach the box, and then we'll check the channels again.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fine. It's just annoying having to troubleshoot this when everything was working before the update.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The refresh has been sent. Please leave the box switched on and tuned to a regular live channel while it processes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've done that. I'm on channel 101 now, and that one is playing normally.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good. Could you try one of the channels that was unavailable earlier and tell me what appears?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm trying channel 204. It still says the channel is currently unavailable.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Understood. I'll check whether channel 204 is included in the current package and whether there's a specific restriction on it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It definitely worked before yesterday. I watch it most evenings.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The channel is included in your package. I'll check whether the box has received the latest channel map.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. Another one, channel 218, is missing from the guide completely. There are a few like that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'll send a channel-map update. Once it arrives, the guide may rebuild automatically, so the channel numbers could take a few moments to return.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right, I've got the guide open. Should I leave it there while it updates?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, please leave it open for now. I'll confirm when the update has been sent successfully.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's still showing the same thing. This is taking longer than I expected.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The system shows the channel-map update as delivered. Please press the Home button on your remote and wait for the menu to appear.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm on the Home menu now. What do I need to select?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Open Settings, then choose TV Setup. Look for an option called Refresh Channels or Channel Scan.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've found Refresh Channels. There's also a full reset option, but I haven't touched that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please select Refresh Channels. Don't choose the full reset, as that could remove your saved settings and recordings.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, I've selected it. It's asking me to confirm that I want to update the channel list.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Confirm that prompt. The box should scan the channel list, and the guide may disappear temporarily while it works.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's scanning now. There's a progress bar moving across the screen.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's expected. Let the scan finish without switching the box off.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's finished. The guide has come back, and I can see some of the missing channel numbers again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Please try channel 204 again, then check channel 218 in the guide.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Channel 204 is playing now. Channel 218 is back in the guide too, and that one works as well.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good. I'll check the account status once more to make sure the package and channel entitlements are still correct.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thanks. I can see the channels now, which is a relief. I was worried I'd need a replacement box.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The package and channel entitlements are showing correctly. There isn't an equipment replacement recommendation on the account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's good. Do you think the update caused the problem, then?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The timing suggests it may have been related to the update, but I can't confirm the exact cause from the information available.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fair enough. At least it's working again. Is there anything else I should do before I finish?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You don't need to make any further changes right now. If the channels disappear again, restart the box once and contact us if the issue remains.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: All right. I'll keep an eye on it tonight. Thanks for walking me through the settings.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're welcome, Daniel. I've recorded the troubleshooting steps and the successful channel refresh in the case notes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Perfect. I can see the channels that were missing, and the ones I tested are playing properly now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's good to hear. Is there anything else you'd like me to check on your S-Net account today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that's everything. Hopefully it stays like this.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your channels are available again, and the channel refresh has completed successfully. Thank you for choosing S-Net.
